property_summary: For all callers, only the designated DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT can successfully invoke setL1BlockValues on the reference contract; the mutant instead only permits address(0), so there exist caller addresses for which the reference accepts and the mutant rejects (or vice versa).
change_summary: Replace the onlyDepositor require check with a different address (address 0) so any sender equal to address(0) can call; effectively disables restriction for normal callers and allows setL1BlockValues to be called by non-depositor only when msg.sender == address(0).
